# Jumping

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Movement](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Jumping)*

When you jump, you make either a Long Jump (horizontal) or a High Jump (vertical). *See also* "[Long Jump](Long-Jump.md)" and "[High Jump](High-Jump.md)."
